description: Returns an event from its link (".../e/<slug>") or slug: its title, description, host, `start` and `end` (UTC) with `when` in words in `timezone`, how many can come (`capacity`), how many are `going` and `waiting`, and its `state`: open (spots are left), full (joining puts you on the waitlist), over (it started) or cancelled. `approval` true means the host approves who joins: say "ask to join", not "join". `summary` says what joining would do, in words. `where` gives only the kind of place (a video call, in person, somewhere else): the address or the link is for guests who are going, in what join_event and get_event_guest return. `initials` are the first letters of the guests going, never their names or emails. Next: call join_event with the person’s name and email.

slug.description: an event’s slug ("founders-dinner" in meettempi.com/e/founders-dinner), or its whole link

timezone.description: the time zone to say `when` in: an IANA time zone such as "America/New_York". Left out, the host’s

name: get_public_event
title: Look up an event by its link
